title: instruments/<id>.json
description: Anything you hold a quantity of. Its price is always per unit, in currency.

id.description: The same as the file name.

kind.description: etc is an exchange-traded commodity; metal is physical metal (coins, bars).

currency.description: What prices are quoted in. The fetcher converts, e.g. USD per troy ounce into EUR per gram.

unit.description: What one price is per: share, g, kg, ozt, or a coin's symbol (BTC). Free-form.

assetClasses.description: The instrument's mix: a 60/40 fund is { "equity": "0.6", "bonds": "0.4" }.

priceSource.description: Where today's prices come from. Absent: prices are entered by hand. Past prices may come from elsewhere without changing it (a gold-api metal's from its futures on Yahoo Finance, older crypto from Yahoo Finance's pairs); the price records say which, in source.

symbol.description: The provider's identifier: a Yahoo ticker (VWCE.DE), a metal code for gold-api (XAU), or for coingecko the coin's CoinGecko ID (ethereum) or its ticker (ETH), in any case. A ticker is resolved through a built-in table of well-known coins, then CoinGecko's search; the file keeps it as typed.
